raw_text: IT EN DE MENU HOME / PROPERTIES / SPAZIOSI GARAGE IN VENDITA | ZONA FARO – LIDO DI JESOLO FOR SALE · GARAGE Spaziosi Garage in Vendita | Zona Faro – Lido di Jesolo FARO · JESOLO · VENEZIA PRICE €41,000 Photos (7) Floor plans (1) 1 / 7 FLOOR AREA 21 m² LIFT No ENERGY CLASS Non soggetto Overview In a highly strategic location just a few steps from Piazza Nember, we offer for sale two individual garages situated side by side. Ideal both as storage for cars and summer equipment, as well as an investment opportunity to generate income. The properties, located on the ground floor with easy access and ample maneuvering space, have generous sizes of 19 m² and 21 m² respectively. Maximum flexibility in purchasing is offered, with the possibility to acquire them either as a single block or separately, depending on different needs.
